rationale: AGI has gapped down ~7.9% with no news catalyst identified, making the move difficult to interpret directionally — it could be a continuation of selling pressure or an overextended gap ripe for mean reversion, but without a clear catalyst the edge is ambiguous. Price is sitting at 9.2% of today's range near the session low with minimal momentum in the last 5 candles (tight, low-volume consolidation), offering no clean breakout or breakdown signal. Given the uncertainty of the gap driver and the lack of a defined structural setup, the risk/reward does not justify adding exposure alongside existing working orders.
